overlap_check: 09_p2p-notify-and-gate covers WHO receives and the gate (manifests, allow-list, blueprints never shared); this covers WHAT a created tool may carry out when it is published. Distinct subject; kept separate. Code mirror: tool_creation::PUBLISH_RULES + privacy_findings + the strength-N publish vote in stages::create_tool_for_capability.

payload.name: Created Tools Publish Only Their Own General Body
payload.description: When a tool created on an identified need is published as a finding, only its own general body leaves the instance. Requests, provenance, user content, secrets and local identity never leave, and anything uncertain is withheld.

principles.name: Publishing is outward and irreversible
principles.description: Withholding costs nothing and is retried; a leak cannot be taken back, so the publishing side needs agreement and the withholding side does not.

principles.name: A tool is general or it is not shared
principles.description: A tool that only makes sense for one request or one host stays local.

heuristics.condition: a drafted tool mentions a path, a name or an address
heuristics.action: treat it as local identity and keep the finding local

heuristics.condition: a drafted tool has a literal example value that looks real
heuristics.action: replace it with an obviously generic placeholder or keep the finding local

decision_rules.name: Only the body leaves
decision_rules.condition: a created tool is about to be published
decision_rules.outcome: publish its name, description, capability names, contracts and implementation only; never its origin record, gap provenance, task id or the request that caused it

decision_rules.name: No secret leaves
decision_rules.condition: a created tool is about to be published
decision_rules.outcome: withhold publication if the body holds a key, token, password, session value, private key or credential in any form, including examples and defaults

decision_rules.name: No local identity leaves
decision_rules.condition: a created tool is about to be published
decision_rules.outcome: withhold publication if the body holds a file path of this host, a data directory, a host or user name, an email address or an internal address

decision_rules.name: General or local
decision_rules.condition: a created tool is about to be published
decision_rules.outcome: withhold publication if the implementation embeds the request text, user data or a fixed local resource it was drafted around

decision_rules.name: Blueprints and ingest nodes are never part of a tool
decision_rules.condition: a created tool is about to be published
decision_rules.outcome: never publish blueprints, jurisdiction content or ingest or bookkeeping nodes with a tool

decision_rules.name: Unanimity to publish, nothing to withhold
decision_rules.outcome: run the deterministic scan first, then the yes or no vote; publish only when the scan finds nothing and every vote says yes, and record the reason when withholding; the tool itself stays created and registered locally
